SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior Court
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001805
DOCKET NO. F00357525
PLAINTIFF – WILMINGTON SAVINGS FUND SOCIETY, FSB, AS OWNER TRUSTEE OF THE RESIDENTIAL CREDIT OPPORTUNITIES TRUST X-C,
DEFENDANTS- 4 BLACKSTONE LLC, ET. AL
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 23rd DAY OF June 2026
between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of LIVINGSTON, County of Essex County and State of New Jersey:
Being known as:
LOT:15; BLOCK: 601 ON THE TAX MAP OF THE TOWNSHIP OF LIVINSTON
OCCUPANCY STATUS: TENANT OCCUPIED
NEAREST CROSS STREET: APPROXIMATELY 95.00FT TO THE NEAREST CROSS STREET KNOWN AS STATE ROUTE 10
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: 100.00FT X 125.00FT X 100.00FT X 125.00FT
PROPERTY IS ALSO BEING SOLD: LIMITED TO TANGIBLE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 4 BLACKSTONE DRIVE, LIVINGSTON, NEW JERSEY 07039 OWNED BY 4 BLACKSTONE LLC
THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND IN THE OFFICE OF THE CLERK OF ESSEX COUNTY DEED INSTRUMENT
NUMBER 2022012154
APPROXIMATE UPSET AMOUNT IS $836,765.95 FOR THE SHERIFF SALE
PURSUANT TO A MUNICIPAL TAX SEARCH DATED APRIL 14, 2026.
SUBJECT TO: 2025 TAXES: $14,910.12 BILLED; $207.58 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $14,702.54 PAID
2026 1ST QUARTER TAXES DUE 2/1/2026, $3,727.53 OPEN PLUS PENALTY
2026 2ND QUARTER TAXES DUE 5/1/2026, $3,727.53 OPEN
2026 3RD QUARTER TAXES DUE: 8/1/2026, TO BE DETERMINED
WATER: ACCT: 44382 0, TO: 1/15/2026, $70.32 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $111.56
OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
SUBJECT TO FINAL READING
SEWER MAINTENANCE FEE: $24.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $48.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $48.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
SEWER: ACCT: 44382 0, TO: 1/15/2026, $45.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $89.74 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
SUBJECT TO FINAL READING
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
4 BLACKSONE DRIVE LIVINGSTON, NJ 07039
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $777,169.44 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
Advertised
DATED: May 6, 2026
HILL WALLACK LLP
21 ROSZEL ROAD
PRINCETON, NJ 08543
609-924-0808
